title: Utility Order for Pierre Part Natural Gas Company, Inc., ex parte. — Order No. U-37792 accepts the Uncontested Stipulated Settlement filed into the record on June 29, 2026. Commission consideration occurred at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

II.            COMMISSION AUTHORITY



               The Commission exercises jurisdiction over public utilities in Louisiana pursuant to Article


IV, Section 21(B) of the Louisiana Constitution.



LA. Const. Art. IV, Sec. 21(B) provides in pertinent part:


               The commission shall regulate all common carries and public utilities and
               have such other regulatory authority as provided by law. It shall adopt and
               enforce reasonable rules,    regulations, and procedures necessary for the
               discharge of its duties, and shall have other powers and perform other duties
               as   provided by law.




III.           STIPULATED SETTLEMENT


               On June       29, 2026, Pierre Part and Commission Staff, pursuant       to   Rule   6   of the

Company,             Inc.   and LPSC   6WDÀ to Schedule Hearing on    Uncontested   Stipulated Settlement,


including Uncontested Stipulated Settlement Term Sheet, Settlement Testimony from Thomas

Broady for Staff, and Settlement Testimony from Ms. Antoinette Vallian on behalf of Pierre Part.

A hearing on the Settlement was held before Chief Administrative Law Judge             ³$/-´ Verzwyvelt

on        July 20, 2026. At the hearing, Staff and Pierre Part introduced testimony and documentary

evidence in support of the settlement. Chief ALJ Verzwyvelt issued Report of Proceedings and


Submission of Stipulation for Consideration by Commissioners on July 20, 2026. The Settlement


resolves all issues in this proceeding.


The terms of the Settlement are:


          1.   Pierre Part be authorized to extend its Rate Stabilization Plan      ³563´      subject to the
